comment: Parallel schedule (25 Nov 2026). Nodes are listed in priority order. 'after' = nodes that must be finished before this one starts. 'base_from' = node whose branch this one is created from (at that branch's head when it starts). P02/P03/P04/P06 branch from P01's head while P01 finishes; P05 stacks on P02, P07 on P06. INT1 (Claude Code) merges all feature branches into integration/features; P08-P10 run in parallel off it; INT2 merges them into integration/qa; P11 then P12.

nodes.note: Other phases (P02, P03, P04, P06) are now being built in parallel in separate git worktrees, branched from an earlier commit of your branch. Keep to your own checklist; a later integration session merges your final branch with theirs, so you don't need to anticipate their code.

Running at the same time as you: P03 (public website; it will link to your plan-purchase entry point), P04 (member app moves to /app/ and becomes an installable PWA; the website takes /), P06 (staff security: MFA, step-up, CSP; its CSP must allow your Razorpay checkout origins, so list them in your Integration notes). P05 (credit packs, which need your checkout) will be built on top of your finished branch, so keep the order/checkout API able to sell a non-plan product such as a credit pack, as the plan describes.

Running at the same time as you: P02 (Razorpay payments), P03 (public website at /), P04 (member app PWA at /app/). P07 will be built on top of your finished branch; P05 is built on P02's branch. Several surfaces your spec mentions are not on your branch yet. Write the CSP so allowed origins are configuration (include the Razorpay checkout origins named in P02's section of PHASE-PLAN.md, and the service worker/manifest needs of a PWA under /app/), build step-up auth as a reusable middleware/helper that later features (P07 broadcast approval and exports) can call, and list in your Integration notes what the integration session must verify on surfaces that don't exist on your branch yet.

Running at the same time as you: P03 (public website served at /), P02 (Razorpay payments and payment notifications), P06 (staff security and CSP). Implement the member app at /app/ exactly as the plan decides and leave / for the website (a minimal placeholder only if needed, clearly marked as such in notes). Wire push categories for payment events behind the notification interface and record the seam for P02 in your Integration notes.

P02 (Razorpay payments) is being built at the same time and is not on your branch. Point the website's buy-plan actions at the plan-purchase entry point described in P02's section of PHASE-PLAN.md, read products and prices from the existing catalogue, and record the exact routes you assume. P04 is moving the member app to /app/ at the same time; follow the plan's routing decision exactly (website at /, member app at /app/) and record any routing change in your Integration notes.

Your branch starts from P02's finished branch, so Razorpay checkout exists here. P04 (member app moved to /app/, push channel, responsive shell) is on a separate branch: build your member UI inside the current member app structure and record in your Integration notes what must move under /app/ and which notifications should use P04's push channel. P06 (staff security) and P07 are on other branches.

Your branch starts from P06's finished branch, so step-up auth and the CSP exist here. P05 (private media, used for attachments) and P04 (push channel) are on separate branches that are integrated later: build against the interfaces the plan describes for them, keep those seams small and obvious, and record each one in your Integration notes.

P08, P09 and P10 run at the same time, each on its own branch from integration/features: P08 adds tests, P09 reviews and fixes code, P10 audits UI/UX and accessibility (findings report; the fixes come in P11).
